name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / Order Sample Compression
details: For nonempty finite binary classes, $\mathrm{OSC}(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm{RTD}^{+p}(\mathcal H)$. More strongly, the right-hand side may be minimized over fixed coordinatewise label flips. Reconstruction in the intersection closure is allowed to be improper for the original class.
proof_source: Corollary \ref{cor:order-positive-projected-teaching} in the survey, using its intersection-closed compression construction and intersection-closure/positive-teaching identity.
witness_verification: For every $n\ge4$, the singleton–cosingleton class has $\mathrm{RTD}^{+p}=n-1$ and $\mathrm{OSC}=3$, by database values #1129 and #1128. Thus the ratio is unbounded, ruling out every reverse affine inequality. The exact order scheme is checked by sync/verify_singleton_cosingleton.py.
